mechanics.text: 共享冷却：Blink Dagger、Overwhelming Blink、Swift Blink、Arcane Blink。使用其中任意一件会使其余物品同时进入冷却。

mechanics.text: 闪烁使用传送机制，并具有以下特性：
mechanics.original: Blink utilizes the teleport mechanic, and has the following properties:

mechanics.text: 以距离不超过 1200 的点为目标时，会直接传送到目标点。
mechanics.original: When targeting a point within 1200 distance, teleports directly onto the targeted point.

mechanics.text: 以超过 1200 距离的点为目标时，会朝目标方向传送 1200 距离。
mechanics.original: When targeting a point beyond 1200 distance, teleports 1200 distance towards the targeted point instead.

mechanics.text: 传送时会躲避飞行中的弹道。
mechanics.original: Incoming projectiles are disjointed upon teleporting.

mechanics.text: 双击施法会以己方泉水前方的点为目标，并遵循上述规则。
mechanics.original: Doubletap targets a point in front of the team's Fountain, following the same behavior as above.

mechanics.text: 泉水相对于地图中心的位置：
mechanics.original: Locations of the fountains, relative to the center of the map:
Radiant Fountain: -7456 / -6938
Dire Fountain: 7408 / 6848

misc.text: 伤害触发的冷却始终会生效，即使物品已丢在地上、位于背包中，或尚未购买。

misc.text: 绿色的盟友塔的真视半径.
misc.original: The True Sight radius of allied Towers, in green.

misc.text: 在红色的可见敌人塔的真视半径.
misc.original: The True Sight radius of visible enemy Towers, in red.

misc.text: 所有监视者的视野半径，绿色，无论联盟.
misc.original: The vision radius of all Watchers, in green, regardless of alliance.

misc.text: 在中性小兵阵营的产卵箱，黄色色，当导向器在产卵盒内变红.
misc.original: The spawn boxes of neutral creep camps, in yellow, turning red when the cursor is within the spawn box.

misc.text: 只有目标的盟友英雄.
misc.original: CTRL cast, can only target allied heroes.

misc.text: Cannot 目标 allied 幻象， 克隆体， Couriers or the 熊灵.
misc.original: Cannot target allied Illusions, Clones, Couriers or the Spirit Bear.

misc.text: 然而，通过将它们拖入物品上来定期分享会有效.
misc.original: However, regular sharing by dragging them item onto them works.

misc.text: Selecting a placed allied 岗哨守卫 shows the name of the player that placed the 守卫， right below the 生命值 bar.
misc.original: Selecting a placed allied Sentry Ward shows the name of the player that placed the ward, right below the health bar.

misc.text: 持有Alt显示了所有盟军哨兵卫队的真视半径，
misc.original: Holding Alt shows all allied Sentry Wards' True Sight radius with a green ring.

misc.text: 摧毁敌人的岗哨守卫将给盟友打印一个聊天通知.
misc.original: Destroying an enemy Sentry Ward prints out a chat notification to allies.

mechanics.text: 不能放置在以下区域:
mechanics.original: Cannot be placed in the following areas:

mechanics.text: 在泉水区域，包括坡道.
mechanics.original: Fountain areas, including the ramp.

mechanics.text: 这就是肉山的坑.
mechanics.original: Roshan's pits.

mechanics.text: 在建筑物和树木的范围内.
mechanics.original: Within the bound radius of buildings and trees.

mechanics.text: 在难过的地形上.
mechanics.original: On impassable terrain.

mechanics.text: For more details， see 侦察守卫 and 岗哨守卫 respectively.
mechanics.original: For more details, see Observer Ward and Sentry Ward respectively.

mechanics.text: 连续的增益效果不堆叠，而是更新时间.
mechanics.original: The buff of successive casts do not stack but refresh the duration instead.

mechanics.text: 在整个寿命内可再生到7*16 (7*7) 生命值.
mechanics.original: Can regenerate up to 7*16 (7*7) health over its full duration.

mechanics.text: 所有电荷可再生至7*16*电荷 (7*7*电费) 生命值.
mechanics.original: All Charges charges can regenerate up to 7*16*charges (7*7*charges) health.

mechanics.text: When targeting an allied 英雄， it grants them a 树之祭祀（共享） in their inventory， instead of granting 生命值 regeneration.
mechanics.original: When targeting an allied hero, it grants them a Tango (Shared) in their inventory, instead of granting health regeneration.

mechanics.text: 如果目标盟友的库存充满，
mechanics.original: If the targeted ally's inventory is full, the item is dropped on the ground.

mechanics.text: Treats the 熊灵 as heroes， and 幻象 as creeps.
mechanics.original: Treats the Spirit Bear as heroes, and illusions as creeps.

mechanics.text: Although it can be cast on other 类英雄小兵 and 克隆体 with inventory， but doing so has no effect.
mechanics.original: Although it can be cast on other creep-heroes and clones with inventory, but doing so has no effect.

mechanics.text: 在创建7秒后，共享的树之祭祀消失.
mechanics.original: A shared Tango disappears 7 seconds after being created.

mechanics.text: 一旦创建，该项的图标上会出现倒计，可见于所有人，显示共享树之祭祀上的剩余时间.
mechanics.original: Once created, a countdown appears on the item's icon, visible to everyone, showing the remaining duration on the shared Tango.

mechanics.text: 连续的增益效果不堆叠，而是更新时间.
mechanics.original: The buff of successive casts do not stack but refresh the duration instead.

mechanics.text: 能够在整个寿命内再生到3.5*16 (3.5*3.5) 生命值.
mechanics.original: Can regenerate up to 3.5*16 (3.5*3.5) health over its full duration.

mechanics.text: 在店主 (即基商店) 的250+400范围内从存储库中收回物品.
mechanics.original: Retrieves the items from the stash within 250+400 range of the Shopkeeper (i.e. the Base Shop). When the items are retrieved, the courier automatically gets the Transfer Items order.

mechanics.text: 如果没有物品可以收回，快递员将转移到派系的泉水，直到下一个订单发行.
mechanics.original: If there are no items to retrieve, the Courier moves to the faction's fountain instead until the next order is issued.

mechanics.text: 在两方，快递员总是步行到店主前面的400个距离，
mechanics.original: On both factions, the Courier always walks to a spot 400 range in front of the Shopkeeper, slightly to its right side.

mechanics.text: 总是前往其党派在地图上的秘密商店，即使敌方的秘密商场更接近.
mechanics.original: Always travels to the Secret Shop on its faction's side of the map, even if the Secret Shop on the enemy side of the map is closer.

mechanics.text: 快递员总是去敌人的秘密商店，即使盟友更接近.
mechanics.original: Same goes for the Alt-Cast, the courier always go to the enemy Secret Shop, even if the allied one is closer.

mechanics.text: 快递员搬到秘密商店后面，在树林中.
mechanics.original: The Courier moves to a spot behind the secret shop, among the trees.

mechanics.text: Returns the items to the stash within 250+400 range of the Shopkeeper (i.e. the Base Shop). When the items are returned， the Courier moves to the 泉水.
mechanics.original: Returns the items to the stash within 250+400 range of the Shopkeeper (i.e. the Base Shop). When the items are returned, the Courier moves to the fountain.

mechanics.text: 在两方，快递员总是步行到店主前面的400个距离，
mechanics.original: On both factions, the Courier always walks to a spot 400 range in front of the Shopkeeper, slightly to its right side.

mechanics.text: 在使用时没有物品在库存中，快递只会转移到泉水.
mechanics.original: When used while having no items in the inventory, the Courier just moves to the fountain.

mechanics.text: 不把锁定的物品移到仓库里.
mechanics.original: Does not move locked items to the stash.

mechanics.text: 要求英雄被解锁.
mechanics.original: Requires hero to be unlocked.

mechanics.text: 允许快递运输，这意味着在受影响时不能减速.
mechanics.original: Grants the Courier hasted movement, meaning it cannot be slowed while affected.

mechanics.text: 快递器没有最大移动速度限制，因此快速爆发将始终应用于快递机.
mechanics.original: The Courier does not have a max movement speed limit. Therefore, Speed Burst will always be applied on the Courier.

mechanics.text: At Level 30， the Courier has (移动速度+value2*29)*(1+%/100) 移动速度 upon cast.
mechanics.original: At Level 30, the Courier has (movement speed+value2*29)*(1+%/100) movement speed upon cast.

mechanics.text: 这种技能在Turbo模式中不使用.
mechanics.original: This ability is not available in Turbo Mode.

mechanics.text: 快递员的确有6个急动行动.
mechanics.original: The Courier permanently has 6 hasted movement instead.

mechanics.text: 这款技能取代了Speed Burst，并且只能在Turbo模式下使用.
mechanics.original: This ability replaces Speed Burst and it is only available in Turbo Mode.

mechanics.text: 在切换时，断开转移物品.
mechanics.original: Interrupts Transfer Items upon toggling.

mechanics.text: 如果在库存或储备中有任何物品，使快递员自动交付.
mechanics.original: Causes the Courier to automatically deliver items if there are any in its inventory or in the stash.

mechanics.text: 在交货后，快递员将自动返回该派系的泉水.
mechanics.original: After delivering the items, the courier automatically returns to the faction's fountain.

mechanics.text: 在两方，快递员总是步行到店主前面的400个距离，
mechanics.original: On both factions, the Courier always walks to a spot 400 range in front of the Shopkeeper, slightly to its right side.

mechanics.text: 在使用时没有物品在库存中，快递只会转移到泉水.
mechanics.original: When used while having no items in the inventory, the Courier just moves to the fountain.

mechanics.text: 由于在英雄上有完整的库存，如果快递商无法交付所有物品，则会出现错误声音.
mechanics.original: The error sound plays if the Courier could not deliver all items due to a full inventory on the hero.

mechanics.text: 除了阿哈利姆魔晶外，货物在交付时自动被其所有者消耗.
mechanics.original: Except for Aghanim's Shard, the item is automatically consumed by its owner upon delivery.

mechanics.text: 如果英雄在转移完成之前死亡，快递员将自动收到返回物品的订单.
mechanics.original: When the hero dies before the transfer finishes, the courier automatically gets the Return Items order.

mechanics.text: 没有转移锁定的物品.
mechanics.original: Does not transfer locked items.

mechanics.text: 要求英雄被解锁.
mechanics.original: Requires hero to be unlocked.

mechanics.text: 给邮递员提供了持续的无敌性.
mechanics.original: Grants the Courier invulnerability for the duration.

mechanics.text: 这种技能在Turbo模式中不使用.
mechanics.original: This ability is not available in Turbo Mode.

mechanics.text: 邮递员获得永久性无损性增益效果.
mechanics.original: The Courier is granted a permanent invulnerability buff instead.

mechanics.text: 快递员与他们的所有者同步， 每个级别立即给予各种奖金.
mechanics.original: Couriers level up with their owners, granting various flat bonuses immediately per level.

mechanics.text: 快递员在重组时间后在其派系的泉水中恢复. 快遞员死时携带的所有物品都无法被玩家访问.
mechanics.original: The Courier respawns at its faction's fountain after its respawn time. All items the Courier carried while dead are inaccessible to the player.

mechanics.text: 否认快递员不会给敌人队一个金钱奖励.
mechanics.original: Denying a Courier does not grant the enemy team a gold bounty.

mechanics.text: 快递员的黄金奖励被授予为所有敌人英雄的不可靠黄金，可以定义为颜色+颜色/LVLGold.
mechanics.original: The Courier's gold bounty is granted as unreliable gold to all enemy heroes, and can be defined as color + color/LVLGold.

mechanics.text: 快递员在肉山的坑里没有视力.
mechanics.original: The Courier does not have any vision inside Roshan's pit.

mechanics.text: 对于每个级别的奖金数量，请参阅下面的图表.
mechanics.original: For the number of bonuses granted on each level, please refer to the chart below.

mechanics.text: Each courier has 移动速度+10*29 移动速度. It also has a gold bounty of ((bounty min+bounty max)/2)+5*29 and rstime/60m respawn time.
mechanics.original: Each courier has movement speed+10*29 movement speed. It also has a gold bounty of ((bounty min+bounty max)/2)+5*29 and rstime/60m respawn time.

mechanics.text: 除了这些水平奖励外，在某些级别上，快递员获得额外效果:
mechanics.original: Besides these level bonuses, the Courier is granted additional effects at certain levels:

mechanics.text: 技能免疫 and the 相位移动 are granted as soon as the game starts.
mechanics.original: Spell Immunity and the phased movement are granted as soon as the game starts.

mechanics.text: 快递员获得飞行状态效果，成为飞行视觉的飞行单位，并使用最小地图标.
mechanics.original: The Courier gains the flying modifier, turning into a flying unit with flying vision, and uses the minimap icon.

mechanics.text: When the Courier gains the flying 状态效果， the 飞行信使 replaces the original unit， disjointing all attacks (Melee melee or Ranged ranged alike) targeted at the original unit.
mechanics.original: When the Courier gains the flying modifier, the Flying Courier replaces the original unit, disjointing all attacks (Melee melee or Ranged ranged alike) targeted at the original unit.

mechanics.text: 解锁了快速爆发技能.
mechanics.original: Unlocks the Speed Burst ability.

mechanics.text: 解锁了盾牌技能.
mechanics.original: Unlocks the Shield ability.

mechanics.text: 移动速度: 移动速度 + 5/LVL
mechanics.original: Movement speed: movement speed + 5/LVL

mechanics.text: 恢复时间:0+45/LVL
mechanics.original: Respawn time: 0 + 45/LVL

mechanics.text: The permanent 相位移动 is granted by a status 增益效果.
mechanics.original: The permanent phased movement is granted by a status buff.

mechanics.text: 快递员可以通过其他单位，包括区间，但不能通过建筑物.
mechanics.original: The Courier can phase through other units, including wards, but not through buildings.

mechanics.text: 这种机制仅适用于Turbo模式.
mechanics.original: This mechanic is exclusive to Turbo Mode.

mechanics.text: 在Turbo模式下，快递机从6级开始，并在英雄达到6级后，与其所有者一起升级.

mechanics.original: In Turbo Mode, the Courier starts at Level 6, and levels up subsequently with its owner when the hero reaches level 6.

mechanics.original: The Courier does not accept any move orders, except using its abilities to move around. Items within the Stash are checked in 5-second intervals and are automatically delivered to the owner.

mechanics.original: Doubletap automatically targets the faction's Fountain upon exceeding the min distance.

mechanics.original: The check radius corresponds to point, the Target Target targeted building's location.

mechanics.original: ChannelTimen Teleport1 + Teleport2 + / × f(n-2)

mechanics.original: The channel time increase does not apply when teleporting to the Fountain.

mechanics.text: 所有技能效应都可见和听到.
mechanics.original: All ability effects are visible and audible to everyone.

mechanics.text: For invisible 敌方单位， the 技能 effects are visible.
mechanics.original: For invisible enemy units, the ability effects are visible.

mechanics.text: While 持续施法， the 传送 destination is marked with the player's color and a sound effect is played.

mechanics.text: Additionally marks the 目标 点-targeted location on the minimap for allied heroes as long as the channel time.
mechanics.original: Additionally marks the Target point-targeted location on the minimap for allied heroes as long as the channel time.

mechanics.text: 认为填充建筑，堡垒和塔楼是普通的建筑物.
mechanics.original: Considers Filler Buildings, Barracks and Towers as regular buildings.

mechanics.text: Grants a 1-second 200-radius flying vision at the 传送 destination for the whole 持续施法 duration， regardless if the 传送 is successful or not.
mechanics.original: Grants a 1-second 200-radius flying vision at the teleport destination for the whole channeling duration, regardless if the teleport is successful or not.

interactions.text: Prevents casting 技能 and cancels the 传送 component when already 持续施法.
interactions.original: Prevents casting ability and cancels the teleport component when already channeling.

mechanics.text: 回城卷轴 refunding 机制:
mechanics.original: Town Portal Scroll refunding mechanics:

mechanics.text: The refunding triggers when 远行鞋 enters the 英雄's main inventory for the first time.
mechanics.original: The refunding triggers when Boots of Travel enters the hero's main inventory for the first time.

mechanics.text: 在背包，储备箱或快递库存中不会触发.
mechanics.original: Does not trigger when in the backpack, the stash, or in the courier's inventory.

mechanics.text: 在升级远行鞋后，第二次触发，按照以前相同的规则.
mechanics.original: Triggers a second time upon upgrading the Boots of Travel, following the same rules as before.

mechanics.text: The refunding is bound to the item， not the 英雄. Acquiring 远行鞋 a second time triggers it again.
mechanics.original: The refunding is bound to the item, not the hero. Acquiring Boots of Travel a second time triggers it again.

mechanics.text: 拆除和重新组装远行鞋也会再次触发它，因为它被认为是新产品.
mechanics.original: Disassembling and Reassembling Boots of Travel triggers it again as well, since it is considered a new item.

mechanics.text: 退款机制只考虑在专门的插槽内的城市门户卷.
mechanics.original: The refunding mechanic only considers Town Portal Scrolls within the dedicated slot.

mechanics.text: 存储器内或地面上的卷轴被忽视，不会退款.
mechanics.original: Scrolls within the stash or on the ground are ignored and not refunded.

mechanics.text: 退款价值基于当前的回售价值: (如果在宽限期内，卖出价值黄金).
mechanics.original: The refund value is based on the current sellback value: (item cost Gold if within the grace period, sell value Gold otherwise).

mechanics.text: 免费的回城卷轴
mechanics.original: Free Town Portal Scroll

mechanics.text: 免费的回城卷轴可以出售，但没有回销价值.
mechanics.original: The free Town Portal Scroll can be sold, but has no sellback value.

mechanics.text: While owning 远行鞋， the 英雄 does not get the free 回城卷轴 upon dying.
mechanics.original: While owning Boots of Travel, the hero does not get the free Town Portal Scroll upon dying.

mechanics.text: 只有检查英雄的主要库存，背包和储备.
mechanics.original: Only checks the hero's main inventory, the backpack, and the stash.

mechanics.text: 没有在地面上检查远行鞋或其他库存 (即快递服务器).
mechanics.original: Does not check for Boots of Travel on the ground, or in other inventories (i.e. Couriers).

mechanics.original: See Teleport notes for Teleport mechanics.

mechanics.original: During the fade time, the hero can cast spells, use items and perform attacks without breaking the invisibility.

mechanics.text: 无形性被破坏在达到咒语或物品的施法前摇时，或者成功地降落攻击.
mechanics.original: Invisibility is broken upon reaching the cast point of spells or items, or upon successfully landing an attack.

mechanics.text: 无形的英雄可以拿起或放下物品，而不打破隐形性.
mechanics.original: The invisible hero can pick up or drop items without breaking the invisibility. However, attacking them breaks it.

mechanics.text: Invisibility from the 聚合神符 does not turn the 英雄 phased， so it still can block unit pathing.
mechanics.original: Invisibility from the Fusion Rune does not turn the hero phased, so it still can block unit pathing.

mechanics.text: Can regenerate up to 300% of a unit's max 生命值 and max 魔法值 over its full duration.
mechanics.original: Can regenerate up to 300% of a unit's max health and max mana over its full duration.

mechanics.text: Can fully regenerate a unit's 生命值 and 魔法值 within 17 seconds.
mechanics.original: Can fully regenerate a unit's health and mana within 17 seconds.

mechanics.text: The regeneration 增益效果 disappears once the 英雄 is at full 生命值 and 魔法值.
mechanics.original: The regeneration buff disappears once the hero is at full health and mana.

mechanics.text: 伤害 greater than after any form of reduction from any player (including allies and self) or 肉山 dispels the regeneration.
mechanics.original: Damage greater than after any form of reduction from any player (including allies and self) or Roshan dispels the regeneration.

mechanics.text: Does not get dispelled by 伤害 flagged as 生命移除.
mechanics.original: Does not get dispelled by damage flagged as HP Removal.

mechanics.text: 当持有者与河流水接触时，将获得河流奖金.
mechanics.original: The river bonuses are applied when the wielder makes physical contact with the water of the river.

mechanics.text: 这意味着，如果它们从垂直上移动出来， 奖金也会丢失，直到它们回到水中.
mechanics.original: This means if they get moved out of it vertically, the bonuses are lost as well, until they land back in the water.

mechanics.text: 河流的奖金绝对不会延续.
mechanics.original: The bonuses of the river do not linger at all.

mechanics.text: Can regenerate up to 10*60 生命值 and 5*60 魔法值 in one minute.
mechanics.original: Can regenerate up to 10*60 health and 5*60 mana in one minute.

mechanics.text: 同时还与腐蚀雾和阿甘尼姆斯莱瑟琳粉碎所制造的河池进行操作，如果是施法者持有.
mechanics.original: Also works with river puddles created by Corrosive Haze and Aghanim Slithereen Crush, if held by the caster.

mechanics.text: 补贴一套奖金攻击伤害.
mechanics.original: Grants flat bonus attack damage.

mechanics.text: If the 持续施法 is interrupted， the 技能 does nothing and goes into 冷却时间.
mechanics.original: If the channeling is interrupted, the ability does nothing and goes into cooldown.

mechanics.text: Can dig up a Bounty， a 治疗药膏 (item cost)， an 魔法芒果 (item cost)， or Kobold.
mechanics.original: Can dig up a Bounty, a Healing Salve (item cost), an Enchanted Mango (item cost), or Kobold.

mechanics.text: 挖掘的Kobold是玩家控制下的，如果没有其他命令，它会自动跟随其所有者追踪范围距离.
mechanics.original: The dug-up Kobold is a under the player's control, and automatically follows its owner follow range distance behind if no other order is given.

mechanics.text: 拥有者盟友的英雄也受益于查找光环
mechanics.original: The owner's allied heroes also benefit from Prospecting Aura

mechanics.text: 科博尔德持续6秒，它不被视为召唤的单位.
mechanics.original: The Kobold lasts for value6 seconds, it is not treated as a summoned unit.

mechanics.text: 挖掘出来的物品不能出售，完全可以分享，不能被摧毁，
mechanics.original: Dug-up items cannot be sold, are fully shareable, cannot be destroyed, and don't count towards Net Worth.

mechanics.text: 挖掘物品的堆可以与常规物品组合在一起，即使常规物品属于不同的玩家.
mechanics.original: Stacks of dug-up items can be combined with stacks of regular items, even if the regular item is owned by a different player.

mechanics.text: 如果发生这种情况，整个堆就无法销售，不能被摧毁.
mechanics.original: If this happens, the whole stack becomes unsellable and cannot be destroyed.

mechanics.text: 如果一堆挖掘出来的物品被组合成一堆普通物品，整个堆积就无法分享，并且保留了所有者.
mechanics.original: If a stack of dug-up items is combined into a stack of regular items, the whole stack becomes unshareable and retains the owner.

mechanics.text: 如果一个堆积的常规物品被组合成一个堆量的挖掘物品，整个堆积就完全可以分享.
mechanics.original: If a stack of regular items is combined into a stack of dug-up items, the whole stack becomes completely shareable.

mechanics.text: 如果两个堆都已经在库存中，这种合并不能发生 (把常规物品的插槽拖入挖掘的物品中的插槽，不会将它们合并，而是交换它们).
mechanics.original: This type of merge cannot happen if both stacks are already in the inventory (dragging the slot of regular items into the slot of dug-up items doesn't merge them, but swaps them instead). The merge must happen by obtaining a stack of regular items while a stack of dug-up items is in the inventory.

mechanics.text: 同样的可靠铁铲不能连续两次产生相同的奖励.
mechanics.original: The same Trusty Shovel cannot spawn the same reward twice in a row.

misc.text: Since 可靠铁铲 can only be obtained past the 7:30th minute mark， the Bounty Runes will be worth at least value2+value3*1 per 英雄.
misc.original: Since Trusty Shovel can only be obtained past the 7:30th minute mark, the Bounty Runes will be worth at least value2+value3*1 per hero.

misc.text: 激活存储的奖励卢纳根据其激活时间提供黄金.
misc.original: Activating a Stored Bounty Rune grants gold based on the time at which it is activated.

misc.text: 奖励轮补充值5再生电荷，除非它已经有超过值5复原电荷.
misc.original: Bounty Rune replenishes value5 Regenerate charges, unless it already had more than value5 Regenerate charges.

misc.text: 给激活鲁纳的团队中的每一个英雄提供可靠的黄金.
misc.original: Grants reliable gold to each hero of the team that activates the Rune.

misc.text: 一个小的黄金颗粒效应短暂从玩家爆发，可见于所有人，
misc.original: A small golden particle effect briefly bursts from the player, visible to everyone, while an ally-only overhead text displays the amount of granted gold.

misc.text: 在Turbo模式下，尽管通知信息显示标准值，但获得的黄金是翻倍的.
misc.original: In Turbo Mode, the granted gold is doubled, despite the notification message showing standard values.

mechanics.text: 随着炎龙之鳞的连续攻击不会堆叠，而是更新时间.
mechanics.original: Successive attacks with Dragon Scale do not stack, but refresh the duration instead.

mechanics.text: The attacks first apply the 负面效果， then their own 伤害.
mechanics.original: The attacks first apply the debuff, then their own damage.

mechanics.text: Deals 伤害 in 1 second intervals， starting 1 second after the 负面效果 is applied， resulting in 3 instances.
mechanics.original: Deals damage in 1 second intervals, starting 1 second after the debuff is applied, resulting in 3 instances.

mechanics.text: 可处理最多66个伤害 (在减少之前).
mechanics.original: Can deal up to 66 damage (before reductions).

mechanics.text: 这不是对待区，而是对抗建筑物.
mechanics.original: Does not work against wards. Works against buildings.

mechanics.original: Interrupts the caster's channeling abilities upon cast.

mechanics.original: First increases maximum health, keeping the current health value. The current health percentage is not kept.

mechanics.text: 然后将当前的生命值增加同样数量. 这不算是治愈，并且绕过任何治愈操纵.
mechanics.original: Then increases the current health by the same amount. This does not count as a heal and bypasses any heal manipulation.

mechanics.text: Upon losing the 增益效果， reduces maximum 生命值， keeping the current 生命值 value. The current 生命值 percentage is not kept.
mechanics.original: Upon losing the buff, reduces maximum health, keeping the current health value. The current health percentage is not kept.

mechanics.text: 这意味着当前的生命值奖金不会被退回.
mechanics.original: This means the current health bonus is not reverted.

mechanics.text: Multiple instances of the 增益效果 do not stack. A re-cast increases the current 生命值 again， and refreshes the existing 增益效果.
mechanics.original: Multiple instances of the buff do not stack. A re-cast increases the current health again, and refreshes the existing buff.

mechanics.text: 网络的速度是900.
mechanics.original: The net travels at a speed of 900.

mechanics.original: Roots the caster upon cast, and the target upon projectile impact.

mechanics.original: The root prevents caster and the target from moving and casting certain mobility spells.

mechanics.original: Provides True Sight over the caster and the target, but only when they were not invisible or within a fade time upon hit.

interactions.text: 在撞击时被阻.
interactions.original: Blocked upon impact.

mechanics.original: The attack range bonus only affects Ranged ranged attacks. Melee Melee attacks only apply the bonus damage.

mechanics.text: Grants the wielder's next attack True Strike and conditional magical 攻击伤害 bonus when not on 冷却时间. The 冷却时间 triggers upon successfully landing an attack on an enemy.
mechanics.original: Grants the wielder's next attack True Strike and conditional magical attack damage bonus when not on cooldown. The cooldown triggers upon successfully landing an attack on an enemy.

mechanics.text: Although the 攻击伤害 bonus values are not displayed in the HUD， it is still considered and directly added to the unit's 攻击伤害.
mechanics.original: Although the attack damage bonus values are not displayed in the HUD, it is still considered and directly added to the unit's attack damage.

mechanics.text: It is not considered by 攻击吸血， crit or 分裂.
mechanics.original: It is not considered by lifesteal, crit or cleave.

mechanics.text: 它只能通过平面减小 (例如魔法伤害屏障) 降低.
mechanics.original: It can be reduced only by flat reductions (e.g. magical damage barrier).

mechanics.text: Since it is considered bonus 攻击伤害， it is not affected by percentage-based 攻击伤害 bonuses or reductions.
mechanics.original: Since it is considered bonus attack damage, it is not affected by percentage-based attack damage bonuses or reductions.

mechanics.text: 必然打击下次 triggers against any attack 目标， but the 伤害 and True Strike are not applied if the 目标 is a building.
mechanics.original: Certain Strike triggers against any attack target, but the damage and True Strike are not applied if the target is a building.

mechanics.text: 不适用于克隆体.
mechanics.original: Does not work for clones.

interactions.text: Does not benefit from the conditional bonus 攻击伤害. Other aspects of 必然打击下次 are fully functional.
interactions.original: Does not benefit from the conditional bonus attack damage. Other aspects of Certain Strike are fully functional.

mechanics.text: 打断持有者的持续施法能力以及其他命令.
mechanics.original: Interrupts the wielder's channeling abilities and other orders upon cast.

mechanics.text: 不干扰定期移动命令.
mechanics.original: Does not interrupt regular move orders.

mechanics.original: Grants the following ability effects:

mechanics.text: 无形性与真视免疫.
mechanics.original: Invisibility with True Sight immunity.

mechanics.text: 奖金是移动速度.
mechanics.original: Bonus movement speed.

mechanics.text: 不允许阶段移动.
mechanics.original: Does not grant phase movement.

mechanics.text: 受到影响的英雄可以起和放弃物品，而不会破坏隐形性.
mechanics.original: The affected hero can pick up and drop items without breaking the invisibility.

mechanics.text: The invisibility breaks upon reaching the attack 点 of attacks， or the 施法前摇 of abilities.
mechanics.original: The invisibility breaks upon reaching the attack point of attacks, or the cast point of abilities.

mechanics.text: 采用英雄的视觉源，除非它们被攻击性曝光源明确影响，否则不会提供来自共享视觉来源的视力.
mechanics.original: The hero does not provide vision from shared vision sources, unless they are explicitly affected by an offensive expose source that reveals unit models.

mechanics.text: 隐形效应在以下条件下消除:
mechanics.original: The invisibility effect is dispelled in the following conditions:

mechanics.text: 在进入另一派的泉水高层区域时.
mechanics.original: Upon entering the elevated fountain area of the other faction.

mechanics.text: 当敌人英雄在驱散半径内存在时，
mechanics.original: When enemy heroes are present within the dispel radius, regardless of their status effects.

mechanics.text: Upon cast， creates an 幻象 of the 施法者， and shuffles their positions.
mechanics.original: Upon cast, creates an illusion of the caster, and shuffles their positions.

mechanics.text: The reappear locations are based on the 施法者's position upon cast， with one of them appearing at the cast location， and the other north， east， south or west from that 点.
mechanics.original: The reappear locations are based on the caster's position upon cast, with one of them appearing at the cast location, and the other north, east, south or west from that point.

mechanics.text: The 距离 between the 英雄 and the 幻象 is 108 range if the 英雄 has a collision size of 24， and 72 if the collision size is 8.
mechanics.original: The distance between the hero and the illusion is 108 range if the hero has a collision size of 24, and 72 if the collision size is 8.

mechanics.text: Though the formation is always the same， the 施法者 and the 幻象 take a random position in the formation and have all the same facing angle.
mechanics.original: Though the formation is always the same, the caster and the illusion take a random position in the formation and have all the same facing angle.

mechanics.text: 这种改造并不能取代以前的幻象.
mechanics.original: Recasting this does not replace the illusions from the previous casts.

mechanics.text: 然而，从中性物品插槽中移除该物品将摧毁所有由此创建的幻象.
mechanics.original: However, removing the item from the neutral item slot destroys all illusions created by it.

mechanics.text: Including 类英雄小兵 and dominated units， excluding 克隆体， wards and 不朽尸王 Zombies.
mechanics.original: Including creep-heroes and dominated units, excluding clones, wards and Undying Zombies.

mechanics.text: 仅增加了基层伤害和受影响单位的主要属性.
mechanics.original: Only increases base damage and that given by the primary attribute of affected units. Raw bonus damage is not increased.

mechanics.original: Units are not disabled during the knockback. They can still turn, attack, cast abilities, and use items. Channeling spells are not interrupted.

mechanics.original: Can move units over impassable terrain. Destroys trees within 100 radius of affected units upon landing.

mechanics.original: The slow and pull debuffs are placed at the same time, so the slow effectively lasts for 2.8 seconds.

mechanics.text: 哈沃克首先使用拉力，慢，然后是伤害.
mechanics.original: Havoc first applies the pull, the slow, then the damage.

mechanics.text: 在从任何单位中服用伤害大于0 (在减少之前) 的触发.
mechanics.original: Triggers upon taking damage greater than 0 (before reductions) from any unit.

mechanics.text: Does not trigger on 伤害 flagged as 生命移除.
mechanics.original: Does not trigger on damage flagged as HP Removal.

mechanics.text: 在激活时，将强驱散应用于持有器上，并治愈它们.
mechanics.original: Applies a strong dispel on the wielder upon activating, and heals them.

mechanics.text: 在驱散后使用治疗剂.
mechanics.original: Applies the heal after the dispel.

mechanics.text: 能拯救持有者免于死亡，即使从0生命值中恢复.
mechanics.original: Can save the wielder from dying, healing them back up even from 0 health.

mechanics.text: 没有保护于即时杀伤效果.

mechanics.original: This also means that it fully works with spell damage amplification and spell lifesteal.

mechanics.original: Successive attacks with Ballista do not stack the debuff, but refresh the duration and knockback instead.

mechanics.text: The attacks first apply the 负面效果， then the 击退每次普通 伤害， then their own 伤害.
mechanics.original: The attacks first apply the debuff, then the knockback damage, then their own damage.
